_comment: TEMPLATE ONLY — copy to .secrets/ocr-samples/expected.json (gitignored, D-10) and fill with the TRUE values read by eye from each real screenshot. Keys are the screenshot filenames named in scripts/ocr-regions.json; field keys are the region names from that file. Write values exactly as displayed in-game (Portuguese locale: 1.234.567 thousand separators, 12,34% decimals, -10,00% negatives) — the spike parses expected and OCR values with the same locale rules. Text fields (sampbasic nickname/job) compare as case-insensitive strings. Tip: run `node scripts/ocr-spike.mjs --dump-candidates` to get a candidate values table to correct by eye. You only need entries for the fields you calibrated rects for.
